name: Hardware-Accelerated AMR Volume Rendering via Homogenization
aliases: Hardware-Accelerated AMR Volume Rendering via Homogenization — AMR Partition Tree Rendering, Tiling AMR domain with grid patches
Tiling AMR domain with grid patches
definition: An interactive DVR technique for AMR data that subdivides the dataset into regions of constant resolution using an AMR Partition Tree (generalized kD-tree) and renders regions using hardware-accelerated DVR.
summary: This method renders AMR data by tiling the domain into non-overlapping homogeneous patches, enabling standard hardware-accelerated ray casting without resampling.
